name: Faisal Mosque
assumptions: Minaret tips 90 m above the ground (dossier; sources say 79 to 90 m), so 82 m above the hall terrace; the head-on photo measures about 84 m terrace to tip.
Hall terrace 8 m up (OSM platform tag, south wall photo); courtyard 2 m lower, joined by a flight of 8 steps (photos of the steps; the rise is an estimate).
Shell apex 36.6 m above the terrace, fitted with a reconstructed camera; Archnet's 40 m is taken as a different datum or the fin tops.
Gable peak 22 m and girder soffit 20.6 m above the terrace, fitted to head-on and drone photos.
Shell plan set to a 75.5 m square centred on the OSM apex: OSM traces 75.5 by 81.2 m but the side photos fit the square; satellite lean is assumed for the OSM long side.
Shell side centres are on the straight side lines; the OSM midpoints agree. Photos support the eave kinks at the side centres.
Minaret neck, spire and skirt proportions fitted to photos; shaft width 7.1 to 6.0 m (OSM's 10.5 m base part up to 50 m is treated as the skirt only).
South gable: 24 lancet ribs about 3 m apart from a close photo; the north gable is built the same (not seen directly).
West (qibla) gable: ribbed, blue-grey from the Esri image only; its exterior was not photographed.
East lattice cell and mullion spacing counted from the twilight photo; panel count may differ by a few.
Perimeter wing height 6.8 m above the courtyard, colonnade depth 3.2 m, and the courtyard wing windows drawn as two continuous rows: estimates from aerial photos.
South stair: position and 18 m width read from one aerial photo; the rise is taken as the courtyard level (6 m).
Crescent and finial metal (dark gold) unconfirmed; lighting colours and floodlit look estimated from night photos.
Mausoleum, SE gate fountain, gardens and car parks are outside this model; the OSM north pool is included.
